subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate opposite word to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The __cynical __investors believed in every word the analysts said.
solution:
The correct answer is: **credulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cynical"** means believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity. (संदेहवादी)

 
 
• **Example: **His cynical view of the world made him question everyone’s motives.
 
 
 
• **"Credulous" **means having or showing too great a readiness to believe things. (अतिसंवेदनशील)
 
 
• **Example: **Children are often credulous and believe in fairy tales.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cynical' **is **'credulous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **credulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distrustful **(अविश्वासी): Feeling or showing a lack of trust in someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was distrustful of strangers and avoided talking to them.
 
 
 
• **Persuasive **(प्रभावशाली): Good at persuading someone to do or believe something through reasoning or the use of temptation.
 
 
• **Example: **Her persuasive arguments convinced the committee to approve the project.
 
 
 
• **Credible** (विश्वसनीय): Able to be believed; convincing.
 
 
• **Example:** The witness provided credible evidence that helped solve the case.
